title: nan
authors: Zahran S.; Moussa A.; El-Sheimy N.; Sesay A.B.
key_contribution: Presents a hybrid machine-learning vehicle dynamic model approach to enhance UAV navigation during GNSS-denied periods using prior flight data and IMU, validated via simulation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
